pictures.scene: John Martin, Belshazzar's Feast — a vast torchlit hall where a prophet in a black robe stands pointing while crowds of banqueters in white recoil with their arms flung up, gold plate heaped along the banquet table and a lit ziggurat rising under a black storm sky beyond, at that time herod the tetrarch heard the reports about jesus and said to his servants, this is john the baptist, he has risen from the dead, that is why miraculous powers are at work in him
pictures.name: pd_martin_belshazzars_feast

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Saint Peter in Prison — an old white-bearded prisoner in a dark red robe sitting on the stone floor of a cell with his hands clasped on his knee, straw scattered about him and two great iron keys lying at his side, the rest of the cell lost in darkness, now herod had arrested john and bound him and put him in prison on account of herodias, his brother philip's wife, because john had been telling him, it is not lawful for you to have her
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_saint_peter_in_prison

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Peasant Dance — villagers dancing at a fair, a man in a black jacket and red breeches striding out with a woman in a white headdress and yellow apron while a boy in red hose swings a girl in a red cap, drinkers at a table and a village church behind them, although herod wanted to kill john, he was afraid of the people, because they regarded john as a prophet, on herod's birthday, however, the daughter of herodias danced before them and pleased herod
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_the_peasant_dance

pictures.scene: Jacques Louis David, The Oath of the Horatii — three sons with their arms flung out together swearing over three swords held up by their father in a crimson mantle, all of them in Roman tunics and sandals on a stone floor beneath three plain arches, so much that he promised with an oath to give to her whatever she asked, prompted by her mother, she said, give me here on a platter the head of john the baptist
pictures.name: pd_david_the_oath_of_the_horatii

pictures.scene: Eduard Bendemann, Jews Mourning in Exile — an old bearded man in a red robe and saffron turban with a chain shackled to his wrist and a lyre lying across his knee, his arm around a fair-haired young woman in dusty rose who has buried her face against him, ivy and a dark tree behind them, the king was grieved, but because of his oaths and his guests, he ordered that her wish be granted and sent to have john beheaded in the prison
pictures.name: pd_bendemann_jews_mourning_in_exile

pictures.scene: Gustave Courbet, A Burial at Ornans — a funeral crowd gathered on a bare hillside, a crucifix carried high against the pale sky, a priest in black and white reading from his book, choirboys in red caps and white surplices, a pallbearer's white cloak marked with black bones and rows of mourners in tall black hats, john's head was brought in on a platter and presented to the girl, who carried it to her mother, then john's disciples came and took his body and buried it, and they went and informed jesus
pictures.name: pd_courbet_a_burial_at_ornans

pictures.scene: Nicolas Poussin, Saints Peter and John Healing the Lame Man — Peter in gold and blue pointing upward with one hand and reaching down with the other, John in green and rose beside him, a lame man in orange sprawled on the temple steps stretching out his arm to them and bystanders crowding in under a white stone portico, when jesus heard about john, he withdrew by boat privately to a solitary place, but the crowds found out about it and followed him on foot from the towns, when he stepped ashore and saw a large crowd, he had compassion on them and healed their sick
pictures.name: pd_poussin_healing_lame_man

pictures.scene: Washington Allston, Elijah in the Desert — a huge bleached dead tree spread over a brown waste with ravens perched on the branch and wheeling in the air, Elijah kneeling small in pale robes at the lower right with his hand raised for the bread a raven drops to him, blue mountains far beyond, when evening came, the disciples came to him and said, this is a desolate place, and the hour is already late, dismiss the crowds so they can go to the villages and buy themselves some food, they do not need to go away, jesus replied, you give them something to eat
pictures.name: pd_allston_elijah_in_the_desert

pictures.scene: Andrea Vaccaro, Tobias and the Fish — a barefoot youth in a blue-grey tunic and brown cloak kneeling on the river bank and hauling a great fish out of the water by its head, an angel's arm entering at the left to point down at it, a dark storm sky above, we have here only five loaves of bread and two fish, they answered, bring them here to me, jesus said
pictures.name: pd_vaccaro_tobias_and_the_fish

pictures.scene: Fritz von Uhde, Saying Grace — children standing at a bare table in a grey cottage room with their hands folded and their heads bowed, empty white bowls and spoons set out in front of them and a loaf of bread waiting on the board, and he directed the crowds to sit down on the grass, taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, he spoke a blessing, then he broke the loaves and gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the people, they all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over
pictures.name: pd_von_uhde_saying_grace

pictures.scene: Jan Porcellis, Fishing Boats in Rough Water — a fishing boat with its small crew riding a choppy brown swell under a wide grey sky, a red pennant streaming from the masthead and a town with a church tower low on the far shore, about five thousand men were fed, in addition to women and children, immediately jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of him to the other side, while he dismissed the crowds
pictures.name: pd_porcellis_vissersboten_in_onrustig_water

pictures.scene: El Greco, Saint Francis in Prayer — a friar in a grey habit and hood kneeling alone in a dark rocky hollow with his hands pressed to his breast and a knotted cord at his waist, ivy hanging above him and a small crucifix set on the rock at the right, after he had sent them away, he went up on the mountain by himself to pray, when evening came, he was there alone, but the boat was already far from land, buffeted by the waves because the wind was against it
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_st_francis_in_prayer

pictures.scene: Ivan Aivazovsky, Jesus Walks on Water — Christ in a glowing white and rose robe standing barefoot on the dark heaving sea with a shaft of light pouring down onto the water around him, the disciples huddled in the shadowed boat at the left with their arms thrown up, during the fourth watch of the night, jesus went out to them, walking on the sea, when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were terrified, it's a ghost, they said, and cried out in fear
pictures.name: pd_aivazovsky_jesus_walks_on_water

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Christ in the Storm on the Sea of Galilee — a small boat heeled over with its bow driven into a white breaking wave, one man clinging to the rigging and another hauling on a rope while one is sick over the side, the rest crowded in the stern around a calm seated Christ, the sail torn and the sky black, but jesus spoke up at once, take courage, it is i, do not be afraid, lord, if it is you, peter replied, command me to come to you on the water
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_christ_in_the_storm_on_the_sea_of_galilee

pictures.scene: Claude Joseph Vernet, The Shipwreck — a dismasted ship heeled onto the rocks in a storm, sailors clinging along the bowsprit and sliding down a rope into the surf, a woman in rose with her arms flung up on the rocks and men hauling a line ashore below a clifftop fortress, come, said jesus, then peter got down out of the boat, walked on the water, and came toward jesus, but when he saw the strength of the wind, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, cried out, lord, save me
pictures.name: pd_vernet_naufrage

pictures.scene: Van Bree, Visit to the Victims of the Flood — a dim beamed hall crowded with flood refugees where a gentleman in black with white hair reaches out to steady a fainting woman in a red skirt and white cap, a uniformed officer in a red sash standing beside him and more officers behind, families seated in rows along the walls under tall windows and hanging lamps, immediately jesus reached out his hand and took hold of peter, you of little faith, he said, why did you doubt, and when they had climbed back into the boat, the wind died down
pictures.name: pd_van_bree_bezoek_aan_de_slachtoffers_van_de_watersnood

pictures.scene: Eugene Delacroix, Christ on the Sea of Galilee — a small boat driven up a green swell under a black sky, Christ lying asleep in a red robe with a ring of gold light about his head while one disciple wrestles with the flapping sail at the mast and others in yellow and blue strain at the oars, then those who were in the boat worshiped him, saying, truly you are the son of god, when they had crossed over, they landed at gennesaret
pictures.name: pd_delacroix_christ_on_the_sea_of_galilee

pictures.scene: Gabriel Metsu, The Sick Child — a woman in a brown jacket and white collar holding a listless child in a yellow jacket across her lap, the child's head fallen back against her shoulder and its bare legs hanging down, a map on the plaster wall and a small painting of the Crucifixion above them, and when the men of that place recognized jesus, they sent word to all the surrounding region, people brought all the sick to him and begged him just to let them touch the fringe of his cloak, and all who touched him were healed
pictures.name: pd_metsu_the_sick_child

lines.text: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the reports about Jesus
and said to his servants, This is John the Baptist; he has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him.
Now Herod had arrested John and bound him and put him in prison on account of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife,
because John had been telling him, It is not lawful for you to have her.
Although Herod wanted to kill John, he was afraid of the people, because they regarded John as a prophet.
On Herod's birthday, however, the daughter of Herodias danced before them and pleased Herod
so much that he promised with an oath to give to her whatever she asked.
Prompted by her mother, she said, Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist.
The king was grieved, but because of his oaths and his guests, he ordered that her wish be granted
and sent to have John beheaded in the prison.
John's head was brought in on a platter and presented to the girl, who carried it to her mother.
Then John's disciples came and took his body and buried it. And they went and informed Jesus.
When Jesus heard about John, He withdrew by boat privately to a solitary place. But the crowds found out about it and followed Him on foot from the towns.
When He stepped ashore and saw a large crowd, He had compassion on them and healed their sick.
When evening came, the disciples came to Him and said, This is a desolate place, and the hour is already late. Dismiss the crowds so they can go to the villages and buy themselves some food.
They do not need to go away, Jesus replied. You give them something to eat.
We have here only five loaves of bread and two fish, they answered.
Bring them here to Me, Jesus said.

And He directed the crowds to sit down on the grass. Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, He spoke a blessing. Then He broke the loaves and gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the people.
They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
About five thousand men were fed, in addition to women and children.
Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of Him to the other side, while He dismissed the crowds.
After He had sent them away, He went up on the mountain by Himself to pray. When evening came, He was there alone,
but the boat was already far from land, buffeted by the waves because the wind was against it.
During the fourth watch of the night, Jesus went out to them, walking on the sea.
When the disciples saw Him walking on the sea, they were terrified. It's a ghost! they said, and cried out in fear.
But Jesus spoke up at once: Take courage! It is I. Do not be afraid.
Lord, if it is You, Peter replied, command me to come to You on the water.
Come, said Jesus. Then Peter got down out of the boat, walked on the water, and came toward Jesus.
But when he saw the strength of the wind, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, cried out, Lord, save me!
Immediately Jesus reached out His hand and took hold of Peter. You of little faith, He said, why did you doubt?
And when they had climbed back into the boat, the wind died down.
Then those who were in the boat worshiped Him, saying, Truly You are the Son of God!
When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret.
And when the men of that place recognized Jesus, they sent word to all the surrounding region. People brought all the sick to Him
and begged Him just to let them touch the fringe of His cloak. And all who touched Him were healed.
